selection_note: Models whose 95% bootstrap AUC interval overlaps the best model are statistically tied on discrimination. Among them XGBoost is selected for production because of its calibration (Brier), exact TreeSHAP explanations, regularisation and portable model format.
why_xgboost: Top-tier discrimination (AUC) and calibration (Brier) on held-out data.
Exact, fast SHAP values via TreeExplainer - required for per-applicant explanations.
Handles non-linear thresholds and feature interactions without manual feature crosses.
Portable native model format (model.json) and millisecond inference latency.
Built-in regularisation (lambda, alpha, gamma) and early stopping limit overfitting.
